title: Learning style preferences of computing students in distance education
reason: Learning-style questionnaires (Honey-Mumford, Grasha-Reichmann, visual/verbal) compared by gender and against norms. AESOP recordings of practical activity were collected but no analysis relates them to styles or success; results are questionnaire-only.

extraction.lms_indicators: AESOP recordings of online programming activity (collected, not analysed here)
extraction.notes: "Of these, 46 (females N=21, males N=25) completed the learning styles questionnaires"; 66 completed the pre-study questionnaire. Activist–avoidant correlation is between two self-report scales. Spaced digits in OCR text.
